reason: I'd probably throw the free 40 documents at it during month end, but paying monthly for something that ends in a Google Sheet when my real work is typing into Jurnal and Accurate? I'd still be retyping, just from a sheet instead of WhatsApp, and my WhatsApp routine already works, ugly as it is.
objection: No export to Jurnal or Accurate, so the slowest part of my job stays mine. Also most of my clients send stuff on WhatsApp, not Telegram, and I'm not sure they'd be happy with a bot sitting in their group reading their receipts.
would_change_my_mind: A direct import into Jurnal or Accurate, so the receipts go straight into my books without me retyping them.
